attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post. The $308 comparison is also his own earlier sentence in the same post.

semantics.note: This is a plain price observation. The 'very strong week' qualifier is kept. The September 11 ~$308 comparison comes from his own adjacent sentence, so including it is fair.

contract.note: The plain reading is fair and ordinary: whole-dollar rounding of closing prices, plus a substantial recent rally. It is not stretched for or against him.

evidence.note: BofA pricing supplement, available April 17, 2026, citing Bloomberg data: the April 15, 2026 ORCL close was $169.81, which rounds to $170.
Morgan Stanley pricing supplement, available September 15, 2025: the September 11, 2025 ORCL close was $307.86, which rounds to about $308.
Investopedia report from April 14, 2026: an 18% gain in Oracle shares since the week began, which fits a very strong week.

reviews.rationale: Filings citing Bloomberg data show Oracle closed at $169.81 on April 15, 2026 (about $170) and at $307.86 on September 11, 2025 (about $308). Contemporaneous reporting shows a gain of about 18% that week. No counterevidence was found. All sources were available before the evaluation date.
